18698-the-recitation.title: The Recitation
18698-the-recitation.creator: GEORGE HERBERT BETTS, Ph. D.
18698-the-recitation.description: A book by GEORGE HERBERT BETTS, Ph. D.. Teaching goes on chiefly in what we call the _recitation_. This is the teacher's point of contact with his pupils; here he meets them face to face and mind to mind; here he succeeds or fails in his function of teaching.

38070-the-norwegian-fairy-book.title: The Norwegian Fairy Book
38070-the-norwegian-fairy-book.creator: Unknown
38070-the-norwegian-fairy-book.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In the old days there lived in Kvam a marksman by the name of Per Gynt. He was continually in the mountains, where he shot bear and elk, for at that time there were more forests on the Fjäll, and all sorts of beasts dwelt in them.

arxiv-2002-01408.title: Apportioned Margin Approach for Cost Sensitive Large Margin Classifiers
arxiv-2002-01408.creator: Lee-Ad Gottlieb, Eran Kaufman, Aryeh Kontorovich
arxiv-2002-01408.description: Abstract We consider the problem of cost sensitive multiclass classification, where we would like to increase the sensitivity of an important class at the expense of a less important one. We adopt an apportioned margin framework to address this problem, which enables an efficient margin shift between classes that share the same boundary.

arxiv-2309-01848.title: A Human-Centric Metaverse Enabled by Brain-Computer Interface: A Survey Thanks: Howe Zhu, Nguyen Quang Hieu, Dinh Thai Hoang, Diep N. Nguyen, and CT Lin are with University of Technology Sydney, Ultimo, NSW 2007, AU (e-mail: howe.zhu@uts.edu.au, hieu.nguyen-1@student.uts.edu.au, hoang.dinh@uts.edu.a
arxiv-2309-01848.creator: Howe Yuan Zhu, Nguyen Quang Hieu, Dinh Thai Hoang, Diep N. Nguyen, and Chin-Teng Lin
arxiv-2309-01848.description: Abstract The growing interest in the Metaverse has generated momentum for members of academia and industry to innovate toward realizing the Metaverse world. The Metaverse is a unique, continuous, and shared virtual world where humans embody a digital form within an online platform.

arxiv-2406-16736.title: Structure of geodesics for Finsler metrics arising from Riemannian g.o. metrics
arxiv-2406-16736.description: Abstract Homogeneous geodesics of homogeneous Finsler metrics derived from two or more Riemannian geodesic orbit metrics are investigated. For a broad newly defined family of positively related Riemannian geodesic orbit metrics, geodesic lemma is proved and it is shown that the derived Finsler metrics have also geodesic orbit property.

arxiv-2506-07924.title: Design and Implementation of a Peer-to-Peer Communication, Modular and Decentral YellowCube UUV
arxiv-2506-07924.creator: Zhizun Xu 1 2 3 , Baozhu Jia 1 5 , and Weichao Shi 2 6
arxiv-2506-07924.description: Abstract The underwater Unmanned Vehicles(UUVs) are pivot tools for offshore engineering and oceanographic research. Most existing UUVs do not facilitate easy integration of new or upgraded sensors. A solution to this problem is to have a modular UUV system with changeable payload sections capable of carrying different sensor to suite different missions.

arxiv-2601-22428.title: Active Learning vs Traditional Lecturing in Introductory Mechanics: A Pooled Pass-Rate Benchmark Under Common Departmental Assessments from a Latin American Institutional Change Initiative
arxiv-2601-22428.creator: Isaac Pérez Castillo, Lidia Jiménez Lara, Orlando Guzman, Juan Ernesto Chavero Amador, Juan Miguel Carrillo Gil, Luis Alberto González Flores, Miguel Angel Morales Olvera, Oscar Enrique Bonfil Urbalejo, Eric Burkholder
arxiv-2601-22428.description: Abstract Improving student success in introductory physics remains a persistent challenge despite the substantial progress made using research-based instructional practices in recent decades. Further, there is a dearth of literature which describes the implementation of these practices in the Latin American context, where resources for instructional change and implementation are often constrained.

barruel-memoires-jacobinisme-t4-1798.title: Mémoires pour servir à l'histoire du Jacobinisme, Tome 4 (Londres, 1798)
barruel-memoires-jacobinisme-t4-1798.creator: Augustin Barruel
barruel-memoires-jacobinisme-t4-1798.description: Tome 4 of Barruel's Memoirs — the Jacobin lodges and the Germanic illuminés; the volume that carried the conspiracy thesis into the 19th century.

pmc-11454728.creator: Brooke C Matson, Felona Gunawan, Anastasia Coppoli, Lihong Jiang, Elizabeth Sanchez Rangel, Renata Belfort De Aguiar, Douglas L Rothman, Graeme F Mason, Janice J Hwang

pmc-11484817.title: Anomalous enhancement of humid CO2 capture by local surface bound water in polar carbon nanopores
pmc-11484817.creator: Zhe Zheng, Yong-Sheng Wang, Miao Wang, Guo-Hua Zhao, Guang-Ping Hao, An-Hui Lu
pmc-11484817.description: Removal of confined space carbon dioxide (CO2) that is in low concentration and with coexisting water is necessary but challenging by physical adsorption method. To make the removal process effective, rendering the nanopore surface hydrophobic to resist water is the popular way.

pmc-11509251.title: Atomically Dispersed High-Active Site Density Copper Electrocatalyst for the Reduction of Oxygen
pmc-11509251.creator: Tao Jiang, Hongli Jiang, Weibin Wang, Hao Mu, Ying Zhang, Bo Li, Haralampos N Miras
pmc-11509251.description: Enlarging the M-Nx active-site density is an effective route to enhance the ORR performance of M-N-C catalysts. In this work, a single-atom catalyst Cu–N@Cu–N–C with enlarged Cu–N4 active site density was prepared by the second doping and pyrolysis (SDP) of Cu–N–C derived from Cu-doped zeolite imidazole frameworks. The half-wave potentials of Cu–N@Cu–N–C were measured as 0.

pmc-11566704.title: Deep learning model for diagnosis of thyroid nodules with size less than 1 cm: A multicenter, retrospective study
pmc-11566704.creator: Na Feng, Shanshan Zhao, Kai Wang, Peizhe Chen, Yunpeng Wang, Yuan Gao, Zhengping Wang, Yidan Lu, Chen Chen, Jincao Yao, Zhikai Lei, Dong Xu
pmc-11566704.description: ObjectiveTo develop a ultrasound images based dual-channel deep learning model to achieve accurate early diagnosis of thyroid nodules less than 1 cm.MethodsA dual-channel deep learning model called thyroid nodule transformer network (TNT-Net) was proposed. The model has two input channels for transverse and longitudinal ultrasound images of thyroid nodules, respectively.

pmc-11600086.title: Flavonoid intakes, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, adult asthma, and lung function: a cohort study in the UK Biobank
pmc-11600086.creator: Nicola P Bondonno, Benjamin H Parmenter, Alysha S Thompson, Amy Jennings, Kevin Murray, Daniel Bech Rasmussen, Anna Tresserra-Rimbau, Tilman Kühn, Aedín Cassidy
pmc-11600086.description: BackgroundGiven their antioxidative stress, anti-allergic, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating effects, flavonoids are hypothesized to play a role in preventing chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and asthma.ObjectivesThis cohort study aimed to examine associations between flavonoid intake and COPD, asthma, and lung function.

pmc-11609412.title: Black Phosphorus Nanosheets-Loaded Single-Atom Gold Nanoenzymes for Enhanced Photodynamic Therapy of Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-11609412.creator: Jianmeng Zhu, Hongqin Wang, Kaiqiang Li, Xiuze Yuan, Wenzhong Hong
pmc-11609412.description: BackgroundConventional treatments for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) lack efficacy and targeting abilities. Photodynamic therapy (PDT) has emerged as a promising alternative for targeted and minimally invasive tumor treatments. However, many biomaterials used in PDT pose biosafety concerns and insufficient enzyme activity often leads to limited reactive oxygen species (ROS) production, resulting in poor PDT efficacy.

pmc-11692148.title: CHOOSING TO FORGO: LIFE-SUSTAINING TREATMENT DECISIONS FOR SELVES AND RELATIVES AMONG TAIWANESE ADULTS
pmc-11692148.creator: Duan-Rung Chen, Su-I Hou, Yuchi Young
pmc-11692148.description: PurposeSince its implementation in 2019, less than 2% of adults in Taiwan have signed Advance Directives (ADs) under the Patient Right to Autonomy Act (PRAA). This research explores how the public views the PRAA and its effect on the decision to decline life-sustaining treatments (LSTs) in hypothetical end-of-life scenarios.

pmc-12577019.title: Effect of corticosteroids on haemoglobinuria resolution among children with blackwater fever at Soroti regional referral hospital, Uganda: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-12577019.creator: Amos Odiit, Patrick Lubogo, Moses Ochora, Isaac Ebiju, Ronald Opito
pmc-12577019.description: BackgroundCorticosteroids are sometimes used in clinical practice in the treatment of blackwater fever (BWF), a complication of severe malaria, despite limited evidence of benefit. This study aimed to compare the time to haemoglobinuria resolution between children with BWF who received corticosteroids and those who did not, and determine if corticosteroid use significantly influences this outcome.

pmc-12603303.title: Evaluating muscle aging during relaxed standing, squats and lunges through electrical bioimpedance
pmc-12603303.creator: Samaneh Zolfaghari, Abdelakram Hafid, Saad Abdullah, Annica Kristoffersson, Mia Folke
pmc-12603303.description: Electrical bioimpedance (EBI) is widely used for body composition analysis and shows promise for assessing muscle activation during physical activities (PAs), particularly in aging. This study investigated EBI’s sensitivity to age-related changes in muscle function by analyzing data from 40 adult participants divided into young (20–29 years), middle-aged (32–60 years), and older (62–73 years) groups.

pmc-12656385.title: RSV Vaccines: Targeting Prefusion F and G Proteins from Structural Design to Clinical Application
pmc-12656385.creator: Dongrunhan Yu, Chengwei Zhang, Yunyi Qi, Ziyi Liu, Di Yang, Nan Zhao, Zunhui Ke, Xiaoxia Lu, Yan Li
pmc-12656385.description: Background: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a major pathogen of acute lower respiratory tract infection (LRTI) in infants, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals. This review focuses on the progress of RSV vaccine development, especially subunit vaccines targeting the fusion protein (F) and attachment glycoprotein (G), aiming to summarize key strategies, challenges, and future directions in the field.

pmc-12688517.title: Modified free pericardial fat pledget technique for intraoperative air leak management in robotic-assisted thoracic surgery
pmc-12688517.creator: Yoshiki Chiba, Masahiro Miyajima, Kazuya Honda, Kazuki Sato, Takeshi Ohyu, Yuki Takahashi, Ryunosuke Maki, Atsushi Watanabe
pmc-12688517.description: BackgroundProlonged air leakage following pulmonary resection is a common complication, and reliable intraoperative repair of lung fistulas is crucial. This study aimed to evaluate the feasibility and efficacy of a modified free pericardial fat pledget technique tailored to solo robot-assisted thoracic surgery.

pmc-13014641.title: Using selective laser trabeculoplasty to manage glaucoma in a child with phakomatosis pigmentovascularis
pmc-13014641.creator: Patricia Bai, Kiara Corcoran Ruiz, Catherine Wang, Julius T Oatts, Javaneh Abbasian
pmc-13014641.description: PurposeTo describe the management and complications associated with using selective laser trabeculoplasty (SLT) to treat elevated intraocular pressure (IOP) in a child with phakomatosis pigmentovascularis (PPV).ObservationsA 13-year-old female with bilateral cutaneous hemangiomas of the face and lower limb length discrepancy presented with elevated IOP in the right eye despite maximal medical glaucoma management.

pmc-13309088.title: Perioperative Management Strategies for Fracture Surgery in Patients With Traumatic Pneumothorax: A Retrospective Case Series
pmc-13309088.creator: Kazuyasu Aoki, Taku Mayahara, Tomohiro Katayama, Kazuyoshi Matsuura, Hiroyuki Arai, Eisaku Maruo, Yuki Higashi
pmc-13309088.description: Introduction: When patients with traumatic pneumothorax require fracture surgery, clinicians must decide how to manage the pneumothorax perioperatively. Options include chest tube placement for the pneumothorax itself, prophylactic drainage before surgery, proceeding with general anesthesia and positive pressure ventilation (PPV) without drainage, using alternative anesthetic techniques to avoid PPV, or delaying surgery until the pneumothorax improves.
